apps.name: DSA.sheet
apps.tagline: Spaced-repetition DSA tracker, 1/3/7 revision priority queue, algorithm vault & blog exporter.
apps.description: Track Striver's A2Z, SDE Sheet, Love Babbar 450, Shradha Ma'am's sheet, or import any custom sheet. Features strict 1/3/7 spaced-repetition revision tracking, approach-level pattern tags, edge-case checklists, a nested Pure Algorithms Vault, and a drag-and-drop Medium/LinkedIn template studio.

v1.7.0 — Configurable Top/Left/Right navigation & mouse-wheel scroll
v1.5.0 — Dynamic Pure Algorithms Vault with nested sections

apps.name: DSA Board
apps.tagline: Interactive drag-and-drop canvas for Arrays, Linked Lists, BSTs, Heaps, HashMaps & Graphs.
apps.description: Visual data structure whiteboard built for algorithm study and dry runs. Drag and drop Array, Stack, Queue, Linked List, BST, Heap, HashMap, and Graph structures onto an infinite canvas, initialize them with comma-separated values, inspect properties in real time, and export boards.
changelog: v1.0.0 — Modular interactive canvas with Array, Stack, Queue, Linked List, BST, Heap, HashMap & Graph

apps.name: JSON Studio
apps.tagline: Instant offline JSON formatter, validator, minifier, and path inspector for API debugging.
apps.description: Zero-latency offline JSON workbench for backend developers. Format, minify, validate syntax with exact error diagnostics, inspect key counts and payload size, and copy clean JSON without sending private API payloads to third-party servers.
changelog: v1.0.0 — Initial release with live validation, tree stats, and minify/prettify

privacy.detail: API payloads are formatted and validated 100% offline on your device.
